Group rides in Sedona, AZ

7 recurring group rides around Sedona, AZ: 5 road, 2 mountain bike, 1 social. 5 roll on weeknights, 2 on weekends. New to group rides? Start with Friday Social Ride (regular and casual) in Cottonwood — it's no-drop, nobody gets left. Want to go fast? VVCC Wednesday Cottonwood Ride runs 10–20 mph depending on the week.
